26/* @brief Episode seed and stable stream identity supplied by the experiment client. */
27struct SensorRandomParams {
28 /* Reflected JSON preserves all bits as a signed integer; high-bit seeds appear negative. */
29 uint64_t episodeSeed = 0;
30 /* Names the node's streams. Empty keys them by the node's graph name (SensorBase::GraphName), so
31 * each node declared in an asset draws its own. */
32 DynamicString processKey;
33
34 MOCHI_STRUCT_BEGIN(superdex::robotics::SensorRandomParams)
35 MOCHI_FIELD(episodeSeed);
36 MOCHI_FIELD(processKey);
37 MOCHI_STRUCT_END()
38};
39
40/* @brief The key of a node's random streams: @p random's processKey, or @p graphName when that is
41 * empty. */
42[[nodiscard]] inline std::string_view SensorStreamKey(
43 SensorRandomParams const& random,
44 std::string_view graphName) {
45 return random.processKey.empty() ? graphName : std::string_view{random.processKey};
46}
